messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: INC-4123 — embeddings-queue 5xx spike (region: eu-west) — urgency: high. Trigger: 5xx rate > 15% over 5m. oncall: @Sam R

pagerduty: Page created: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-4123 — responders notified.

Sam R: I'm on it, grabbing initial context now.

Neha K: acked. joining. any customer-facing impact known?

Sam R: quick check — spikes across the embeddings worker fleet. Some pods returning 502/503, one pod showing OOMKilled restarts in the last 10m. Likely either batch sizing or memory regression.

Liam O: adding runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-5xx — steps 1-3 are memory/scale checks.

Sam R: running initial commands:
```
# list pods
kubectl get pods -n embeddings -o wide
# tail logs for flapping pod
kubectl logs pod/emb-worker-7f9d8 -n embeddings -c worker --tail=200
```

incident-bot: Escalation policy: if unacknowledged by SRE in 5m escalate to rotation.

Sam R: logs show repeated OOMKilled + "OutOfMemoryError" in worker loop. heap / memory spike during large-batch encoding. Pod restarts approx every 90s.

Anya P: ok — we should throttle batch size and fallback to emb-model-v1-small while we stabilize. That will reduce memory pressure.

Neha K: notifying CS and product: opened ticket CS-2245 and pinged CS lead. Customers using realtime search may see degraded results.

Sam R: executing temp mitigation — reduce MAX_BATCH_TOKENS, roll canary to 10% of traffic, and route remaining to emb-v1-small.

Sam R: command: `kubectl set env deployment/emb-worker MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=1024 -n embeddings` then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/emb-worker -n embeddings --record`

Liam O: adding routing change: `redwood router set-weight embeddings-prod emb-v1-small=0.3 emb-v1=0.7` (doing a conservative ramp).

Sam R: canary rolling out now. watching metrics: 5xx rate falling on canary pods.

incident-bot: Metric update: 5xx rate was 18% at alert time. Current aggregated 5m 5xx rate: 7.2% (down from peak).

Anya P: great. continue observing for 15m, if stable we'll promote the env change cluster-wide and progressively shift traffic. Also collect heap profiles from suspect pod for postmortem.

Sam R: collected heap profile and core logs: `/artifacts/INC-4123/heap-2026-03-14.tar.gz`. Will upload to the ticket.

Neha K: CS updated customers who reported issues, added note about temporary routing to emb-v1-small and ETA for full stabilization.

Sam R: applied env change to all worker replicas. rolling update completed at 2832109920. 5xxs down to 1.1% in eu-west.

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by Sam R, escalation stopped.

ops-runbook: Please ensure follow-ups: run heapdiff on suspect commit, check recent model/quantization merge, and schedule a canary test for larger batches.

Anya P: assigning follow-ups —
- Sam R to file short postmortem (preview by EOD)
- Liam O to validate routing fallback automation (owned)
- Neha K to coordinate customer comms and post-incident summary

Sam R: marking as resolved in PD and closing alert. I will create the postmortem: INC-4123-embeddings-oom-regression.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-4123 marked resolved at 2832109950.

Sam R: closing notes: root cause appears to be a regression in batch memory accounting introduced in commit b3f4d2 (model-orchestration). Temporary mitigation was to reduce MAX_BATCH_TOKENS and shift 30% traffic to emb-v1-small. Long term: revert/regression fix + add a canary that validates memory envelope for large batches.

Neha K: thanks all — nice quick work. will circulate postmortem and customer-facing summary after Sam posts draft. :thumbsup:
